nom: Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream for Dark Circles

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry under-eyes report the gel-cream feels hydrating and locks in moisture, with one noting it helps dryness on the lids that is otherwise hard to treat.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who did not consider themselves sensitive still report burning, itching, redness and scaling under the eyes, sometimes lasting weeks to months.
segments.mature: A self-described dry, mature-skin reviewer prefers this formula over the Lift + Sculpt version, citing hydration and reduced wrinkle visibility.
segments.oily: One reviewer with an oily, breakout-prone complexion warns that this serum caused her blemishes and advises others with similar skin to avoid it.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers citing fine lines and wrinkles report softer or less noticeable lines, firmer skin, and a lifting effect with regular use; a couple say results are subtle or reverse once they stop using it.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report the product hydrates and moisturizes the under-eye area, with soft, plumped skin the next morning; no dissent on this point among positive reviewers.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers report the product caused red, swollen, or inflamed skin around the eyes, some describing it as chemical-burn-like; others state it never caused redness for them.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe peeling, scaling, or scabbing skin after use, indicating barrier damage in some users, while many others report no irritation at all.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the product shrank and cleared skin tags and sun spots, an isolated benefit not echoed elsewhere.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with oily, breakout-prone skin reports the product caused blemishes; another describes small pimples appearing under the eye alongside irritation.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers highlight that the product is non-greasy and absorbs without residue, even those with generally oily-leaning skin around the eyes.

extraits.texte: I was so excited to try my new products, especially this gel-creme. After a few days of use, first I started to experience itchy eyes.At first, I thought it was due to seasonal allergies. However, the itching progressed to burning on the outside. I was on vacation and fortunately my eye doctor called in a prescription for antibiotic eye drops. I continued however using the product becuase I had no idea it was causing my issues. When we got back from vacation, I was still having the symptoms and went to the eye doctor. They tried a different prescription. A few nights later I was awakened feeling like the skin around my eyes was on fire. I had used the gel that night before bed as I have been since I got it. That morning, my left eye was swollen, I had a like a welt-like area in the corner of my left eye, both eyes under the eyes were fiery red, and they burned to the touch. In that moment, I realized that the only thing different I had been doing was using this product! I stopped using it.Later than day, my skin started to wrinkle up under my eye and the skin looked scaly. As the days progressed, I had to deal with ugly scaling scabs under my eyes which made work very difficult as I am on virtual meetings daily. It's now a week later, and my skin is still peeling, and occassionally buring in the more burned areas. extraits.titre: My skin is damaged after using this eye gel
extraits.texte: I was so excited to try this eye gel. I bought myself the blockbuster holiday set and could not wait to try everything out. I ignored the bad reviews about this gel causing skin irritation because I do not have sensitive skin. About a week after starting this eye gel, I noticed a small red area under my left eye and what looked like three small pimples under my right eye. I also noticed burning and stinging under my eyes. The red patch under my left eye became extremely dry and scaled, the skin is now starting to flake off, and the three spots under my right eye have become very itchy and my under eye is swollen. I stopped using this product about a week ago and I'm still healing. The skin around my eyes looks terrible right now. So far I have not reacted negatively to the other products I'm using. I actually got a gift set for my sister, too, that includes this product, but I am concerned about her using it because I do not want her to have this happen to her. I think I may just pitch it. I have never had my skin react so badly to any other product I have used in my life. It looks like this works well for a lot of people, so if you buy it, I hope it works for you. I cannot recommend this product due to my experience.

Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt has a very light, slippery consistency with a smooth and buttery application. It's a Great eye elixir for those who prefer a lighter and less dense formula.This serum irritated my eyes made them red, gooey, and excessively watery which is very atypical for me. This product may be cost effective as a little goes a long way and the wand is super useful for gaging single applications. However, the bottle I recieved was less than half full. I honestly can't vouch for the product's efficacy. I ran out of product too soon. But it feels fairly nice on the skin and is effortless to apply. Those with oily, breakout-prone complexions may want to avoid this serum as it did cause me blemishes. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

extraits.titre: Hydration and Brightness for Tired Eyes
extraits.texte: I've really enjoyed using the Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Cream Skincare Gift Set over the past few weeks. My under eyes tend to be dry, with dark circles and the beginnings of fine lines, so I was curious to see if these products would make a difference. The serum has a lightweight texture that sinks into my skin quickly without feeling sticky, and the eye gel-creme feels soothing and hydrating with a silky, balmy finish that isn't heavy. With consistent use, I've noticed my under-eye area looks brighter and feels much more moisturized, and my fine lines appear softer. While I mostly use the set at night, I've also applied it during the day under makeup and it layers beautifully without causing any pilling. This set has really helped refresh and revive my eye area. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I've tried both Advanced Night Repair Multi-Recovery eye cream and Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream. I have dry, mature skin. And I prefer the Multi-recovery eye cream. This eye cream is thicker and feels like it nourishes and hydrates the skin and locks it in. In the morning, I notice my skin is more hydrated and my wrinkles are less noticeable. I used it for 3 weeks, and I'm very happy with the result so far. It's not scented, but has a subtle earthy scent. This set comes with full size & travel size of eye cream, and travel size serum. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I have used the Advanced Repair Gel-Creme for over a year. This is undoubtedly the best product I have ever used. It is so soft and slides on and around the eye easily. Dryness on the lids is sometimes very hard to get rid of This product does the trick along with minimizing fine lines and darkness under eyes. You can't go wrong using this product.

This eye cream doesnt do much at all. I been using it over a month and don't see a difference in my eyes. It very thick but it does absorb pretty well. I use this with another serum eye cream under this one. I won't buy this again.
